Plays for South Florida Cricket League, Southeast Region, Florida. Played for USA in West Indies Cricket Board [WICB] Red Stripe Bowl tournament, 1998-99 in Jamaica and in ICC tournament in Canada in2001 and Argentina in 2002 Played for USA in 2001 also played for US team in ICC Six Nations Challenge in UAE 2004.
